name: Ventspils Castle
scope: The restored Livonian Order Castle at Ventspils, including its four wings, southeast tower, courtyard skylight and adjoining mapped heritage wall.
era: Museum configuration following the 2001 and 2012 restoration phases.

originalReview.notes: The 2008 exterior view already published on Qualla exactly matches Brimful45’s public-domain own work in the Wikivoyage transfer ledger. The image shows the shallow ochre lime render, pale blind arch, white window frames, tiled hip roof and courtyard wall.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with Brimful45’s original public-domain exterior photo already published on Qualla. The building footprint, historic tower location and native terrain establish the rest of the model frame.
